common.searchHint: Search by name, task or keyword
common.noResults: No matching tools. Try another keyword.
common.localNote: Conversions and files stay in your browser, without tracking. WebSocket communicates with your chosen server only after you connect.
common.manualCopy: Copy unavailable. Select the text and copy manually.
common.idle: Enter input or load an example to get started.
common.dirty: Input changed. Run again to update the result.
common.welcome: A little less friction. A lot more done.
common.welcomeNote: Your everyday developer tools, thoughtfully organized.
common.emptyFavorites: Star a tool to keep it close at hand.
common.emptyRecent: Tools you visit will appear here.
common.offlineNote: First use needs a connection. Download all resources for offline use. Clearing requires another download.
common.offlineError: Offline operation failed. Check your connection and browser support.
common.confirmClear: Clear offline cache? Next use will need a connection.
common.confirmExample: Loading an example replaces your input. Continue?
common.fileNote: Text limit: 5 MiB. Hash file limit: 100 MiB. Files stay local.
common.limit: Input exceeds the size or count limit.
common.sensitiveReset: Reset cannot be undone for sensitive tools.
common.notVerified: Decoded, NOT signature verified. Decoding does not establish validity.
common.legacyHash: MD5 / SHA-1 are for compatibility and non-security checks only.
common.obfuscationNote: Obfuscation is not encryption. Size and runtime cost may increase; reverse engineering remains possible.
common.formulaNote: Formula protection prefixes risky cells with an apostrophe and can change their content.
common.cronNote: Standard Cron, not Quartz. Restricted day-of-month and day-of-week use OR semantics.
common.jsonpathNote: Safe JSONPath subset: $, fields, indexes, *, recursive fields and slices. Script filters are not executed.
common.dateNote: Use ISO dates or offset timestamps. Ambiguous or nonexistent local times are rejected.
common.htmlNote: Results are plain text; HTML is never rendered.
common.hmacNote: An empty key requires explicit opt-in. Signature encoding follows the selected output format.
common.aesNote: Raw keys use HEX/Base64. GCM ciphertext includes a 128-bit tag. Encryption generates a fresh IV.
common.mockNote: Seeded and reproducible. For test fixtures, never for security.
common.unitNote: Results depend on root/parent font size and viewport dimensions; 6 decimal places.
common.regexNote: JavaScript regular expressions, isolated in a Worker with a 1-second timeout.
common.curlNote: Parses POSIX, Windows CMD and common PowerShell cURL without sending requests. Unsupported flags and dynamic shell expressions are rejected. Redaction uses common field names; review before sharing.
common.cacheStatus: Offline availability is not guaranteed until caching completes.

common.draftLimit: Draft was not saved: over 256 KiB or storage is unavailable.

common.loadingError: Tool resources could not be loaded. Reconnect and retry, or download offline resources in Settings.

tools.json-schema.title: JSON → Zod / Schema
tools.json-schema.description: Infer Zod validators or JSON Schema from sample data.
tools.json-reshape.title: JSON Reshape
tools.json-reshape.description: Pick and rename fields, flatten data or index arrays by a key.
tools.har-analyzer.title: HAR Analyzer
tools.har-analyzer.description: Inspect local HAR request timings, errors, repeats and response sizes.
tools.svg-tools.title: SVG Tools
tools.svg-tools.description: Sanitize and optimize SVG, then export JSX or a data URI.
tools.image-tools.title: Image Tools
tools.image-tools.description: Resize local images and export PNG, JPEG or WebP with size comparison.
tools.qr-code.title: QR Code
tools.qr-code.description: Generate downloadable SVG QR codes or read a local image.
tools.env-diff.title: Environment Diff
tools.env-diff.description: Compare .env keys and values or generate a value-free example.
tools.i18n-check.title: Translation Check
tools.i18n-check.description: Check JSON translations for missing keys, empty strings and placeholder mismatches.
tools.text-encoding.title: Text Encoding
tools.text-encoding.description: Inspect BOM, line endings and invisible characters; convert UTF-8, UTF-16 and GBK.
fields.pickFields: Fields to keep (comma-separated, blank for all)
common.harRedacted: URL query values are hidden; repeats use full original URLs. Content sizes are decoded response sizes, not network transfer totals.
common.inferredSchema: Inferred from samples; add business rules, unseen fields and value constraints manually.
common.svgSanitized: Scripts, styles and external resources were removed; verify the preview against the original.
common.imageNote: Output is a still image without animation or original metadata; JPEG uses a white background.
common.encodingDownload: Clipboard text is Unicode; use Download encoded file for the selected encoding. Choose the source encoding manually.
common.binaryFileNote: Image limit: 20 MiB and 32 million pixels. Files stay in browser memory and are never uploaded.
common.encodingNote: Select the file encoding manually. Conversion rejects characters that the target encoding cannot represent.
common.imageInput: Select a local image, then run.
errors.fileRequired: Select a local image file first.
errors.imageFormat: Invalid image format or unsupported output format.
errors.qrNotFound: No QR code found. Try a clearer image.
errors.encoding: The file does not match the selected source encoding.
errors.unrepresentable: Some characters cannot be represented in the target encoding. Choose UTF-8.
common.svgFileNote: SVG limit: 512 KiB. Processed locally without loading external resources.
common.jsonDiffNote: Leave the identity key blank to compare by position. Use a key such as id to ignore object order; duplicate or missing identities are rejected.
common.i18nNote: Checks {name}, {{name}} and common printf placeholders. Full ICU MessageFormat syntax is not parsed.
common.languageHint: Change interface language; automatic mode follows your browser language
tools.typescript-json.title: TypeScript → Sample JSON
tools.typescript-json.description: Generate sample JSON from interfaces or type aliases, including nested references.
common.typeSample: Sample values only. Unions use the first non-undefined branch; strings use example. Leave the root name empty to use the first declaration.
errors.typescriptSyntax: Invalid TypeScript syntax. Check the type declarations.
errors.typeReference: Root or referenced type not found. Include all required declarations.
errors.typeCycle: Circular type reference cannot produce a finite JSON sample.
tools.json-mock.title: JSON → Mock Data
tools.json-mock.description: Generate up to 1,000 deterministic fixtures from a JSON sample.
workbench.help.json-mock: Generate up to 1,000 deterministic fixtures from a JSON sample. Recognizes email, date, name and ID field names; not a business model inference engine.
tools.request-converter.title: Request Code Converter
tools.request-converter.description: Convert cURL, literal fetch and axios(config) to fetch/Axios/cURL/Python.
workbench.help.request-converter: Convert cURL, literal fetch and axios(config) to fetch/Axios/cURL/Python. No execution. Variables, template expressions, unsupported options are rejected. Output is not automatically redacted.
tools.openapi.title: OpenAPI Code Generator
tools.openapi.description: Supports OpenAPI 3.x JSON component types, local schema references and request skeletons.
workbench.help.openapi: Supports OpenAPI 3.x JSON component types, local schema references and request skeletons. No YAML, external references, automatic path/auth/body substitution or complete SDK generation.
tools.websocket.title: WebSocket Debugger
tools.websocket.description: Connects to the entered server only after you click Connect.
workbench.help.websocket: Connects to the entered server only after you click Connect. HTTPS requires wss. Browsers cannot set arbitrary handshake headers; server origin policies apply. Logs stay in memory, capped at 200; navigation disconnects.
tools.spreadsheet.title: Excel / CSV Workbench
tools.spreadsheet.description: Open XLSX/CSV or enter a JSON object array.
workbench.help.spreadsheet: Open XLSX/CSV or enter a JSON object array. Merge matching headers, deduplicate, select columns, filter by substring and split exports. Cached formula results only; no styles/macros preserved. Up to 10,000 rows / 200 columns. Spreadsheet exports prefix formula-like strings with an apostrophe.
tools.sql-tools.title: SQL Data Tools
tools.sql-tools.description: Generate INSERT from JSON using standard quoted identifiers, derive types from simple CREATE TABLE, or display positional parameter substitution outside quotes/comments.
workbench.help.sql-tools: Generate INSERT from JSON using standard quoted identifiers, derive types from simple CREATE TABLE, or display positional parameter substitution outside quotes/comments. DDL excludes table constraints and complex dialects. No database connections; use parameterized queries in applications.
tools.format-converter.title: JSON / XML / YAML / TOML / INI
workbench.help.format-converter: Convert structured formats. XML attributes use an @ prefix; DTD/entities are disabled. Target formats may not represent every JSON shape; INI allows simple keys and one-level sections. Comments, dates and number representation can change; review output.
tools.text-analyzer.title: Text Statistics & Duplicates
tools.text-analyzer.description: Count Unicode code points, UTF-8 bytes, word-like segments, lines and duplicate lines.
workbench.help.text-analyzer: Count Unicode code points, UTF-8 bytes, word-like segments, lines and duplicate lines. Group report capped at 10,000 items. Segmentation is lexical, not semantic Chinese word segmentation.
tools.image-css.title: Image → Base64 / CSS
tools.image-css.description: Convert a local PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/AVIF to a data URI or CSS background-image.
workbench.help.image-css: Convert a local PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/AVIF to a data URI or CSS background-image. One file, up to 5 MiB; SVG is excluded.
tools.css-converter.title: CSS & Object Converter
tools.css-converter.description: Accepts CSS declaration lists or JSON style objects.
workbench.help.css-converter: Accepts CSS declaration lists or JSON style objects. Camel-case conversion, px→rem and property sorting. CSS→object rejects duplicate properties and !important. No JavaScript execution; full stylesheets are excluded.
tools.font-preview.title: Local Font Preview
tools.font-preview.description: Load local WOFF/WOFF2/TTF/OTF and preview font size, weight and line height.
workbench.help.font-preview: Load local WOFF/WOFF2/TTF/OTF and preview font size, weight and line height. Up to 10 MiB. Font removed on navigation; no uploads or system font installation.
tools.table-generator.title: HTML / Markdown Table
tools.table-generator.description: Edit a JSON object array to generate HTML or Markdown tables.
workbench.help.table-generator: Edit a JSON object array to generate HTML or Markdown tables. Columns use the union of keys; HTML cells are escaped and user content is not executed.
tools.image-batch.title: Batch Images
tools.image-batch.description: Up to 50 local images: downscale proportionally, convert, adjust quality, watermark and ZIP download with sequential names.
workbench.help.image-batch: Up to 50 local images: downscale proportionally, convert, adjust quality, watermark and ZIP download with sequential names. Static frames only, metadata removed; JPEG uses white background. Combined decoded pixels capped at 64 million.
tools.image-stitch.title: Image Stitcher
tools.image-stitch.description: Horizontal, vertical or grid collage with proportional cell fit, spacing and background.
workbench.help.image-stitch: Horizontal, vertical or grid collage with proportional cell fit, spacing and background. PNG output; canvas capped at 32 million pixels.
tools.image-palette.title: Image Color Palette
tools.image-palette.description: Extract quantized dominant colors, counts and gradient CSS.
workbench.help.image-palette: Extract quantized dominant colors, counts and gradient CSS. Samples at 100×100 and skips low-alpha pixels; approximate palette, not a lossless color census.
tools.image-annotate.title: Image Annotations
tools.image-annotate.description: Add rect, arrow, text, number or blur (pixelation) via annotation JSON, in original-image pixels.
workbench.help.image-annotate: Add rect, arrow, text, number or blur (pixelation) via annotation JSON, in original-image pixels. Click the preview to position marks. Up to 100 items. Pixelation is not guaranteed irreversible; cover sensitive material completely.
tools.markdown-workbench.title: Markdown Workbench
tools.markdown-workbench.description: Live Markdown preview, safe HTML export, heading outline and browser Print to PDF.
workbench.help.markdown-workbench: Live Markdown preview, safe HTML export, heading outline and browser Print to PDF. Preview removes scripts, external resources and forms; no remote images or code execution.
tools.pdf-tools.title: PDF Workbench
tools.pdf-tools.description: Merge in selected-file order, extract/reorder pages, split pages, or render PNG.
workbench.help.pdf-tools: Merge in selected-file order, extract/reorder pages, split pages, or render PNG. Page syntax: 3,1-2. Up to 500 merged pages, 300 selected pages, 30 rendered pages. No password bypass; uses local PDF.js.
tools.text-cleaner.title: Text Cleaner
tools.text-cleaner.description: Trim lines, remove blank/duplicate lines, normalize NFC/NFKC and convert common Chinese punctuation to ASCII.
workbench.help.text-cleaner: Trim lines, remove blank/duplicate lines, normalize NFC/NFKC and convert common Chinese punctuation to ASCII. NFKC changes compatibility characters such as full-width text.
tools.document-diff.title: Document Content Diff
tools.document-diff.description: Compare pasted document text by lines or words and export a diff.
workbench.help.document-diff: Compare pasted document text by lines or words and export a diff. CSV/table text can be pasted. Not a binary DOCX/PDF or layout comparison.
tools.audio-editor.title: Audio Trim & Volume
tools.audio-editor.description: Trim by seconds, adjust volume and fade in/out; export 16-bit PCM WAV.
workbench.help.audio-editor: Trim by seconds, adjust volume and fade in/out; export 16-bit PCM WAV. Input codec depends on browser support. Output capped at 10 minutes, stereo and 30 million samples. Navigation/cancellation discards output.
tools.video-frames.title: Video Frames
tools.video-frames.description: Enter comma-separated timestamps in seconds to capture local video frames as PNG/ZIP.
workbench.help.video-frames: Enter comma-separated timestamps in seconds to capture local video frames as PNG/ZIP. Up to 30 frames, no upscaling. No video transcoding; decoding depends on the browser.
tools.subtitle-tools.title: Subtitle Formats & Timing
tools.subtitle-tools.description: Convert SRT/VTT, shift timing and merge bilingual subtitles with exactly matching timelines.
workbench.help.subtitle-tools: Convert SRT/VTT, shift timing and merge bilingual subtitles with exactly matching timelines. Negative times rejected. VTT styles, positioning and cue IDs are not preserved; complex NOTE/STYLE blocks excluded.
tools.file-rename.title: Batch File Rename
tools.file-rename.description: Preview rename plans by default; enable Export copies to download ZIP without touching originals.
workbench.help.file-rename: Preview first; Export copies downloads a ZIP without changing originals. Supports sequence, literal or regex replacement (g/i/u only, 5-second timeout). Duplicate/invalid Windows names are rejected.
tools.file-duplicates.title: Duplicate File Finder
tools.file-duplicates.description: Group local files by chunked SHA-256 and mark duplicates.
workbench.help.file-duplicates: Group local files by chunked SHA-256 and mark duplicates. No deletion. Up to 50 files, 50 MiB each, 150 MiB total.
tools.file-signature.title: File Signature Inspector
tools.file-signature.description: Inspect first 32 bytes for common PNG/JPEG/GIF/PDF/ZIP/ICO/GZIP/WebP/WAV signatures and compare extension.
workbench.help.file-signature: Inspect first 32 bytes for common PNG/JPEG/GIF/PDF/ZIP/ICO/GZIP/WebP/WAV signatures and compare extension. ZIP does not distinguish Office formats. Unknown is not a safety verdict; no malware scan.
tools.text-redact.title: Text Redaction
tools.text-redact.description: Mask emails, mainland Chinese mobile numbers, 18-character ID patterns and common token/password fields.
workbench.help.text-redact: Mask emails, mainland Chinese mobile numbers, 18-character ID patterns and common token/password fields. Rules can miss or overmatch; review before sharing. Persistent drafts disabled.
tools.password-generator.title: Passwords & Passphrases
tools.password-generator.description: Uses unbiased Web Crypto randomness; passwords include each selected character class.
workbench.help.password-generator: Uses unbiased Web Crypto randomness; passwords include each selected character class. Passphrases contain 4–12 words from a small built-in list. No strength certification; persistent drafts disabled.
tools.certificate.title: X.509 Certificate Inspector
tools.certificate.description: Parse PEM X.509 subject, issuer, serial, validity, signature algorithm and SHA-256 fingerprint.
workbench.help.certificate: Parse PEM X.509 subject, issuer, serial, validity, signature algorithm and SHA-256 fingerprint. Parsing/expiry checks only; no trust-chain, signature, revocation or hostname validation.
tools.date-workbench.title: Time & Date Workbench
tools.date-workbench.description: Compare a specific instant across zones or calculate a remaining-seconds snapshot.
workbench.help.date-workbench: Compare zones at an explicit ISO instant, or use a pausable live countdown. Exported values are run-time snapshots. Include an offset in the target time.
tools.split-bill.title: Split Bills
tools.split-bill.description: Split expenses by payer and participants using cents; remainders follow participant order.
workbench.help.split-bill: Uses integer cents. Finds the minimum transfer count for up to 12 nonzero balances (2 million search nodes max); larger groups use a greedy plan. No payments or exchange rates.
tools.unit-converter.title: Unit Converter
tools.unit-converter.description: Convert length, mass, temperature, speed and storage within the same dimension.
workbench.help.unit-converter: Convert length, mass, temperature, speed and storage within the same dimension. KB is decimal, KiB binary. 12 significant digits; not a precision metrology tool.
tools.lottery.title: Weighted Draw
tools.lottery.description: Random weighted draws with optional uniqueness.
workbench.help.lottery: Random weighted draws with optional uniqueness. Up to 1,000 candidates; integer weights 1–10,000. Candidate lists can be copied as JSON. No payments or independently audited draw service.
tools.pixel-editor.title: Pixel Art Editor
tools.pixel-editor.description: Click cells to paint, choose colors or erase.
workbench.help.pixel-editor: Click cells to paint, choose colors or erase. Editable square color matrices up to 32×32. Export PNG and box-shadow CSS. Blank grid is 16×16; export scale 1–40.
tools.ascii-art.title: Image → ASCII Art
tools.ascii-art.description: Convert local images to luminance-based ASCII art, 10–200 columns.
workbench.help.ascii-art: Convert local images or entered text to luminance-based ASCII art, 10–200 columns. Transparency composites over white. Copy/download text; wide characters may affect alignment.
tools.screenshot-beautify.title: Screenshot Beautifier
tools.screenshot-beautify.description: Add a two-color gradient background, rounded corners, shadow and window frame to local screenshots; export PNG.
workbench.help.screenshot-beautify: Add a two-color gradient background, rounded corners, shadow and window frame to local screenshots; export PNG. No uploads. Canvas capped at 32 million pixels.
tools.code-card.title: Code Image Cards
tools.code-card.description: Local syntax highlighting, line numbers, window title and background; PNG export.
workbench.help.code-card: Local syntax highlighting, line numbers, window title and background; PNG export. Up to 300 lines / 50,000 characters; long lines subject to canvas limits. No code execution.
tools.link-tools.title: Link Toolbox
tools.link-tools.description: Extract HTTP(S) URLs from text or append query parameters in bulk, retaining duplicates.
workbench.help.link-tools: Extract HTTP(S) URLs from text or append query parameters in bulk, retaining duplicates. No network requests. Existing tools provide detailed parsing and QR generation.
tools.decision.title: Weighted Decision
tools.decision.description: Rank options by weighted averages of 0–10 scores.
workbench.help.decision: Rank options by weighted averages of 0–10 scores. Nonnegative weights with positive total. Reverse negative criteria such as cost before entering scores.
tools.browser-check.title: Browser Environment Inspector
tools.browser-check.description: Inspect browser, viewport, capabilities, storage estimates and known permission states.
workbench.help.browser-check: Inspect browser, viewport, capabilities, storage estimates and known permission states. Does not request permissions or upload reports. Reports can identify device characteristics; review before sharing.
tools.workflow.title: Tool Workflows
tools.workflow.description: Chain up to 10 text conversions from an explicit built-in allowlist.
workbench.help.workflow: Chain up to 10 text conversions from an explicit built-in allowlist. Each step has tool and optional params. No scripts/network. Supports workflows such as CSV→JSON→TypeScript; batch image pipelines use Batch Images.

common.help-unit-converter: Convert length, mass, temperature, speed and storage within the same dimension. KB is decimal, KiB binary. 12 significant digits; not a precision metrology tool.
common.help-lottery: Random weighted draws with optional uniqueness. Up to 1,000 candidates; integer weights 1–10,000. Candidate lists can be copied as JSON. No payments or independently audited draw service.
common.help-link-tools: Extract HTTP(S) URLs from text or append query parameters in bulk, retaining duplicates. No network requests. Existing tools provide detailed parsing and QR generation.
common.help-decision: Rank options by weighted averages of 0–10 scores. Nonnegative weights with positive total. Reverse negative criteria such as cost before entering scores.
common.help-workflow: Chain up to 10 text conversions from an explicit built-in allowlist. Each step has tool and optional params. No scripts/network. Supports workflows such as CSV→JSON→TypeScript; batch image pipelines use Batch Images.
workbench.annotationClick: Click image to position an annotation
errors.filesRequired: Select local files or load an example first.
